_doc: Control meanings: ../domain/controls.md; physical bindings: ../domain/controller-profiles.md. _controls are inert references, not activation instructions. Active/movement abilities without _controls have no hybrid activation assigned here; no source input shape is inherited. Class ranks 1-3 activate slots 1-3; separate ultimate column activates slot 4, except Assassin Camouflage remains only rank/slot 3. alpha-tree needs = points in previous node (roots 0, D20). Current effects/gates and later approvals: ../domain/3_Classes.md#ability and #skill-tree-a; source balance below does not override them.
